decay.note: DRAFT first-pass values (ecs-architecture.md section 2.10). Reputation is a self-stabilizing quantity: without new events it drifts back toward 0. Negative events deliberately weigh more than positive ones.

note: Reputation changes only through events. Helping one faction against another moves both sides (help villagers against scavengers: villagers +10, scavengers -10). Personal reputation lives on the creature (Reputations); faction attitude lives on the faction entity.

tiers.-100_-50: hostile: attack on sight, refuse trade
tiers.50_100: friendly: prices x0.8, help and share information
